entities.name: Communal Feasting
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The earliest evidence of large-scale communal feasting comes from Natufian sites in the Levant. Hundreds of people gathered to eat, drink, and celebrate. Göbekli Tepe (11,000 BCE) may have been built specifically for feasting — the first purpose-built banquet hall.
